item: X1 — replace hard-coded model paths with bundle resolution

hardware.NOT_the_published_bench_machine: V02_REPORT.md figures were measured on 2 vCPU Xeon (AVX-512) / 8 GB. Numbers in this file are from different hardware and must never be merged with those.

defect.was: Five scripts hard-coded /home/claude/vanian-build/models/... and two also hard-coded the llama-server path, so each was unrunnable on any machine but the original build host. Three carried duplicate copies of the SHA-256 digests.
defect.note: run_atomic.sh's --server argument and run_holdout_v02.sh's --model/--model-sha pair were missed by the search pass and caught by test_no_caller_duplicates_a_manifest_digest_except_the_declared_mirror and test_none_of_the_patched_callers_mentions_the_build_host. The test asserts over an explicit caller list rather than trusting a search, which is why it found them.

fix.manifest: deploy/syntriass/models.manifest.json — 4 pinned models, digests cross-checked between run_all.sh and BASELINES.md
fix.resolver: deploy/syntriass/resolve_model.py — precedence MODELS > SYNTRIASS_BUNDLE/models > /opt/syntriass/current/models (the location README.md section 3 installs to)
fix.integrity: SHA-256 is authoritative and subsumes the documented size; a mismatch is refused, never warned about

recorded_run.exit_code_meaning: EXIT_NOT_STAGED from resolve_model.py — the intended, documented refusal

scene_outcomes.Setup: PASSED — fresh install, keys, 19 documents across 3 organisations ingested
scene_outcomes.Scene 1: RAN, DID NOT PASS — returned error 'Inference: /opt/syntriass/current/models/qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf: No such file or directory'. Needs a live model. Note the path: X1 propagated into the Rust runtime's config via mkconfig.py, so even the runtime now names the bundle path instead of the build host.
scene_outcomes.Scene 2: PASSED — strategy 'Exact', the model-free exact-rules path, live
scene_outcomes.Scene 3: STOPPED at the model resolution with exit 3 and the operator-facing message

recorded_run.before_this_item: the same run attempted /home/claude/vanian-build/models/... and failed without saying how to fix it

incidental_unblocks_required_to_produce_.verification: all 5 splits byte-identical to the digests pinned in the tracked MANIFEST.json (train de1acd44…, val c4755127…, test_id 2a316291…, test_ood 6e8eced6…, test_para d4103088…)

incidental_unblocks_required_to_produce_.cause: deploy/syntriass/README.md section 1 documents 'Python >= 3.10 with numpy'; methods/extractors.py:102 imports sklearn.linear_model
incidental_unblocks_required_to_produce_.fix: installed numpy 2.4.6 and scikit-learn 1.9.1; sidecar health then returned ok with train_rows 1200, matching the manifest
